answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent network can mandate Proof of Space commitments on persistent media. Nodes store unique cryptographic tables and answer uncacheable read challenges over localized copper buses. Adversaries must incur the verifiable hardware cost of dedicating physical drive sectors per identity, denying ephemeral bots an operational haven. However, the relentless tide of audit queries consumes disk bandwidth, throttling honest agent throughput.
